about_the_game:
A visual novel with RPG elements


«Freedom is measured in lives.»

America is dead. The ashes of the past are scattered over the wastelands, where everyone is on their own. You are the leader of a band of raiders, whose specialty is the capture and sale of slaves.

The goal is simple: to accumulate enough wealth to leave everything behind and disappear forever into the luxury of Old Vegas.

But the road to paradise runs through betrayal, blood and constant risk.

Every step brings you closer to your dream... or to a bullet in the back.

Key Features:

  • Does Solo shoot first? Choose who you will be — a charismatic leader, a ruthless butcher or a cold-blooded strategist. The parameters of the hero affect the style of the game and the available solutions.

  • Control the monsters: the raiders have a character. If you play the good guy too much, you'll lose your credibility. If you push too hard, there will be a riot.

  • Difficult moral choices: prisoners, allies, prey — everything can become both a resource and a threat.

  • The wasteland breathes death: randomized events along the way, mutant attacks, ambushes of competitors and hunger — challenges do not wait in turn.

There are no right solutions here. Just you, your gang, and a path strewn with ashes.

Old Vegas is waiting. But will you live to see it?

content_descriptors.notes:
The game's plot describes the real villains. Criminal slavers. 

Some of them use drugs, others rape their slaves, and others are capable of shooting an innocent person or shooting themselves if the situation becomes desperate.

In this world, anyone can lose a limb or contract a fatal disease. Life in the wasteland will not spare anyone.
